programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The residents of Midsomer Mallow are preparing for the 'Perfect English Village' competition even though a few days earlier saw the murder of local thief and lothario, Peter Drinkwater (Orlando Bloom). Barnaby and Troy discover that he had been stabbed with a pitchfork while squatting at an abandoned farm. The detectives must deduce if one of his burglary victims, his accomplice in the robberies or another disgruntled villager may have been the killer.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Shortly before his retirement, Superintendent Pringle arrests a local poacher for the murder of a tramp during a fox hunt in woodland close to the village of Upper Marshwood. DCI Barnaby is unsure that the poacher was the killer. Upon returning from holidaying in France, Barnaby is proved right, when the poacher's father is murdered with his own shotgun. As they reopen the investigation, they find many hidden secrets amongst the villagers.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A disused airfield at Cooper's Cross is where Simon Bright's vintage car is found by Frances Kirby. Laura is nowhere to be found, both Barnaby and Jones, newly promoted to DS, need to work out if it was a suicide pact gone wrong or whether it was murder and track down Laura.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Faith Alexander arrives in Midsomer to meet her long-lost uncle Rex Masters. She receives a real shock, when she discovers that Rex's friends had been told she had died in a plane crash. Things become complicated when Rex's body is found in the nearby river. Barnaby and Jones quickly turn up trying to workout who would wish Rex harm. Several friends of Rex come forward with multiple 'new' wills each being sole beneficiary.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Whilst on a business trip to China, Alan King suddenly dies. The family firm, King's Crystal is in financial uncertainty, including plans to close its factory in Midsomer Magna. Six months later Alan's widow Hilary and his brother Charles are married, much to the chagrin of Alan's son Ian. With family feuds and factory workers angered by the loss of their jobs, there's many motives in the mix. When Peter Baxter, the firm's accountant is found dead, stabbed with a Masonic dagger.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The Midsomer Rocks festival is due to take place and music fans descend on neighbouring fields to enjoy the fiesta. programme.title: Midsomer Murders

programme.desc: Sergeant O'Rourke and Corporal Agarn bring Samantha Oglesby, a professional marriage broker, to Fort Courage. The hope is for every soldier in F Troop to find a suitable wife. However, Agarn has a disturbing dream which leads to chaos among the men.

programme.title: F Troop
programme.desc: A wealthy carpetbagger named Big Jim Parker arrives and claims to have bought the land that Fort Courage is on. He plans to evict the F Troop from the fort. Captain Parmenter and all of the men rally to try to save Fort Courage and their livelihood.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles
programme.desc: When failed prospector John Hicks Adams is elected sheriff of Santa Clara County, he must prove that he won't be a bust as a lawman too. Just weeks into the job, his courage is tested when a band of stagecoach robbers begins terrorizing the area.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles
programme.desc: After a bank robbery, two Pinkerton detectives join forces to track the notorious Missouri Kid. During a shootout, the Missouri Kid kills seasoned detective Charles Schumacher, leaving young George Dougherty to finish the job and avenge his death.

programme.title: Into The Wild Frontier
programme.desc: Joe Walker doesn't head west to seek fame and fortune, but his trailblazing explorations across the uncharted frontier usher in a golden age of expansion and settlement that help create the United States as we know them today.

programme.title: The Young Riders
programme.desc: Buck continues to grieve over Ike's untimely death. Meanwhile, Cody falls for Julia, the widow of a gunrunner who has a young son named Danny. Cody helps them both adjust to life on their own.

programme.title: Blind Spot
programme.desc: Cheyenne rides into a small cotton town to pick up a friend's son to try to reunite a family bitterly divided by the Civil War. He soon battles hatred and greed by a vigilante gang that is holding the town captive.

programme.title: Thief

programme.title: Ronin

programme.title: Walking Tall (2004)
programme.desc: When it comes to laying down the law, one man can make a difference! Action superstar Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson takes no prisoners as he fights for justice and crushes corruption in this story of one man who takes a stand and takes back his town!

It’s a case that the cops can’t crack, but when Greer sends in his new task force – The Mod Squad – they quickly uncover a crime ring involving drugs, hookers...and dirty cops!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: What would you do if you found out your spouse was hiding a major secret? Dr. Phil sits down with couples struggling to figure out their next step after learning a deep, dark secret. Joseph and Natalie have been married less than six months and both say they’re very much in love, but a playful game of dress up awakened repressed feelings from Joseph’s childhood, and now he questions his sexual identity. Are his cross-dressing desires just a phase or indicative of lifelong transgender identity? Is Natalie prepared to hear the truth, and can their marriage survive? And, Carrie caught her husband, Ed, in not just one huge lie, but many! Ed has so many secret ex-wives, children and grandchildren that Dr. Phil has to use a dry erase board to sketch out the new family tree! Are his lies marriage deal- breakers, or can this couple start over from scratch? And, does Ed have more to confess? Don’t miss this compelling show!

programme.title: Dr. Phil

programme.title: Dr. Phil

programme.title: Dr. Phil

programme.title: Dr. Phil

programme.desc: Is a mother too unfit to see her own child?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: My Dad Was The Breast Pump Bandit (Part 1)
programme.desc: Lauren says she resents her parents, Laura and John, claiming that as a teen, Laura stole her identity and racked up $50,000 in debt – a claim Laura denies – and that John had affairs on her mom and drank alcohol and used drugs with her and her teenage friends. John admits he was the “party dad,” but claims he was just trying to bond with Lauren. But is this just the tip of the iceberg? Dr. Phil drops the bombshell that John spent nearly two years behind bars and was dubbed the “Breast Pump Bandit” by his city’s local news. It’s a Dr. Phil episode you cannot miss!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A Mother-in -Law accuses her Daugher-in-Law of political corruption, and even murder. Can these two call a truce with the help of Dr Phil?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues to speak with parents, Liz and Jim, about why each blames the other for their son’s drug addiction. Liz says she blames what she calls Jim’s abusive parenting philosophy for their son retreating to drugs, which Jim vehemently denies. Find out what happens when Jim faces his daughter, Chloe, and son, Nic. Will they support their mother’s accusations against their father?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Do you ever wonder how your favorite Dr. Phil guest is faring since being on the show? Dr. Phil follows up with some of his most talked about guests.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Andy and his wife, Bridget, say they were petrified after receiving a call from a scammer posing as a kidnapper who claimed he was holding their daughter, Sam, hostage for ransom money. Dr. Phil explains to the frightened couple that this trending scam is called “virtual kidnapping,” as he instructs the audience on how to recognize these types of scammers. Then, Dr. Phil meets with Debra Newell, the real woman behind the popular podcast and hit Bravo series Dirty John. Debra was a single, successful business owner who had raised her four children when she decided she was ready to go online to try to find love. Then, Debra met John, a man who first seemed like a charming, intelligent doctor but later revealed he was emotionally abusive with a dangerous and criminal past. Detective Julia Bowman also talks about how unbeknownst to Debra, she had arrested John in 2013 for stalking and harassing an ex, and he later tried to put a hit out on the detective.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Steve, 53, says in the past 29 months, he has sent more than $100,000 to “Kelly,” his overseas “wife” whom he met on a dating website in 2012. Steve says “Kelly” is an American woman stuck in Nigeria trying to secure a $25 million fortune left to her by her parents. He admits she is also one of several clients who say they have large inheritances pending that he is trying to help -- deals Steve believes will make him millions. Despite never meeting “Kelly” in person and only talking to her on the phone a few times, Steve insists they are a “match made in heaven” -- which is why he sent her money for a marriage certificate. But Steve’s sister, Tammy, and niece, Kidist, say they believe he is being scammed, and they want him to cut ties with “Kelly” -- and his other so-called clients. Dr. Phil digs deep in search of answers. Is “Kelly” really the woman of Steve’s dreams, or is he being conned by a catfish? And, Steve has spent more than $135,000 so far on all of his clients -- is he ready to call it quits?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A mother's concern escalates as her daughter's party lifestyle spirals into substance abuse and reckless behavior.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Today Dr. Phil unlocks the mystery of birth order and sibling relationships. We’ll meet an eldest daughter who took on the role of family authority figure as a child and now no longer wants that responsibility. Dr. Phil also helps a guest with concerns about being alone as an adult, because she was an only child. Dr. Phil explains how birth order creates structures and roles for children without them knowing it, and how it’s the parent’s responsibility to make each child feel special.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: My Friend is Obsessed with Me
programme.desc: Traci says her former friend, Jinda, is obsessed and infatuated with her. Traci says Jinda began texting her about 50 times a day after they first met -- texts that soon became over-the-top proclamations such as, “I can’t get you out of my mind," and “I swear I will love you the right way.” Traci says she thought Jinda just needed a friend but then grew more uncomfortable as, she claims, Jinda was also inappropriately affectionate with her children, began texting her friends whom she had never met, and even tried to touch and kiss her. Traci claims Jinda crossed the line when she tried to sabotage her marriage, so she cut off communication with her. But is Jinda getting the message? Traci says Jinda still texts and drives by her house, and she worries what Jinda might do next. Jinda admits to being "needy and clingy" but does she see that she's overstepped her boundaries? Can Dr. Phil help her rein in her behavior? Then, Kari says her sister, Holly, stabbed her in the back when she took Kari’s ex-husband’s side during their divorce -- and, after not speaking for three years, she wants an apology. Holly says she’s not sorry and that Kari is the one who needs to apologize. Can Dr. Phil end the silence between these sisters?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Does love really conquer all? James, 41, quit his job and left his wife and three children to pursue a relationship with his 18-year-old former student, Jordan. The couple says they're not breaking any laws, want to set the record straight with Dr. Phil, and want Jordan's mother, Tammie, to stop her Facebook "smear campaign" against them. In a national exclusive, Tammie confronts James for the first time on Dr. Phil’s stage. Find out how the attraction began and why Tammie says James is lying. Were there secret meetings before Jordan turned 18? And, what does Jordan stand to lose? Parents, how would you react if your child started a relationship with his or her former teacher?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: My Ex Puts Fame Before Our Daughter
programme.desc: A couple is battling for custody of their 10-year-old daughter.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Feuds between neighbors are examined.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Secrets, aliases, disguises. These are some of the tactics Dr. Phil's guests have used to manipulate people and get what they want. See what happens when these liars and cons are confronted.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Marie, a divorced mother of four, says she has been a fugitive -- wanted for attempted murder -- for the past two months after attempting to attack her ex-husband with a hammer. What does she say caused her to carry out the violent act? And, is she ready to turn herself in?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Do you know someone who makes big mistakes over and over? Dr. Phil gives his guests the wake-up calls they desperately need to stop repeating their destructive behavior.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Jeremy owns his own funeral escort company but says he’s being falsely accused of impersonating a police officer, and if convicted, could face up to 85 years in prison. Jeremy says videos from his funeral processions have been leaked online, received millions of views, and as a result, he is being victimized in his community and misrepresented in the media – and now, he and his attorney want to set the record straight. Dr. Phil meets Jeremy and takes a closer look into components of his business, including his motorcycle, uniform and badge. Is Jeremy “playing cop” or just doing his job? And, what’s on Jeremy’s duty belt? You won’t want to miss part one of this two-part show.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Levi and Bob say their once-perfect, honor roll student, Tiffani, has changed into someone they don’t know, and she is terrorizing the family. Levi says the 15-year-old is mean and evil, drinks, steals and fights with her every day. In one altercation, Levi says Tiffani spit in her face, punched her and threatened to push her off a balcony, and now she’s afraid for her life. Bob says Tiffani doesn’t respect discipline or any authority -- including the police. Tiffani has been in juvenile detention three times, and Bob says each time she's released, her behavior only escalates. Dr. Phil takes a look into their family dynamics. How might Bob and Levi be contributing to Tiffani's recklessness? Plus, hear from Tiffani. You may be surprised to hear why she says she acts out.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: How would your life change if Publisher’s Clearing House rang your doorbell? A scenario many of us would like to live out, but for some, sudden wealth has been a double edged sword. Tune in as families tell Dr. Phil their tales of fast fortunes and the pain it’s caused. You’ll meet two sisters – one was on the verge of financial disaster as the other received an unexpected windfall. It’s been nothing but heartache since, and their love and trust for one another is now bankrupt. Plus, you’ll meet two families who received millions from a casino slot machine only to have their happiness robbed by the “one armed bandits.”

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Meet a “runaway bride” who’s already called off five weddings and she’s only 26! Then, meet another guest who’s frustrated because her fiancé won’t set a wedding date. He's canceled two previous engagements and says marriage "freaks him out." What does the future hold for these two? Plus, a heartbroken woman whose fiancé called the wedding off a month before her big day. Should she wait for him to come around? Find out what every bride needs to know before walking down the aisle.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Melanie says her 19-year-old daughter's boyfriend, Michael, is a gay, drug abusing gangbanger. What would cause her to have such a negative opinion of him? And is there any truth to her allegations? Learn why Michael initially agrees to a drug test, and then refuses. Will he finally break down and take it? And why does Melanie’s daughter, Caylin, support him anyway, regardless of the outcome? Then, Lori says her 17-year-old daughter, Mackenzie, is obsessed with a boy who's already broken up with her four times. Find out why Dr. Phil has a stern message for this mom.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: How has the role of the man evolved in the modern family? One woman claims her husband provides her with everything—except love and affection. He says he only knows how to provide financially. Can Dr. Phil help them find a balance and save their marriage of 17 years? Then, one guest entered into a new relationship after leaving his wife and kids. Now, his guilt is causing him to lie, manipulate and become physically abusive. Find out what Dr. Phil has to say to these men about the true measure of a man’s success in a relationship!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A family says their relative is a cult leader who calls herself "Mother God."

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Tony Fort, a young man who was abducted by a family friend when he was 11 years old, reunites two decades later with the FBI agent that he says saved his life. Go inside the dramatic rescue of Tony from a convicted sex offender. Plus, Alicia Kozak says she was just 13 when she was lured from her home by an internet predator and placed in a dog collar, chained to the floor, and horrifically abused. Hear her inspiring story of survival.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Brittany says her boyfriend, Tim, is evil, abusive and unfaithful. “I sometimes think that he could kill me,” she says. So, why is she still considering marrying him? Tim admits that he can’t control his rage and to choking Brittany while he was holding their 6-month-old daughter -- and he fears he’ll accidentally hurt the baby next. Tim also confesses to cheating on Brittany with both men and women, and even finding male companions online. Can Dr. Phil help Tim reign in his temper before it's too late? And, Tim promises that the violence and infidelity are a thing of the past, and he’s ready to make a change -- but is he? Don’t miss Dr. Phil’s eye-opening advice for this couple and anyone in an abusive relationship.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Tony Fort was just 10 years old when he says a man his mother trusted to watch him began grooming him, brainwashing him, and sexually abusing him. Tony says he was vulnerable and lonely, and he believed the older man was his best friend. Tony claims the man gave him dangerous, addictive drugs, telling him it was candy, and videotaped Tony being sexually abused. The man even followed Tony’s family when they moved to a new state, and he eventually abducted Tony. Authorities say they believe he had a sinister and dark plan for the little boy. Today, Tony speaks out for the first time about what happened to him.

Written by Jay Davis and Directed by Donte "Diesel" Williams, Not Another Black Movie addresses issues that effect many families whether they be rich or poor, black or white. programme.sub-title: My black triangle UFO sighting & Rendlesham Forest UFO encounter Part 1
programme.desc: In this episode of “The Basement Office,” Steven Greenstreet reveals a close encounter he had with a black, triangular UFO in Provo, Utah, in 2003. Nick Pope helps Steven come to terms with what he saw, and helps explain why so many similar UFO sightings go unreported. Then, Charles Halt discusses his shock at his UFO sighting in Rendlesham Forest in 1980 and the audio recording he made during the event.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show
programme.desc: In the local Pygmy dialect of south central Africa, Mokele Mbembe means 'able to stem the flow of rivers.' The Pygmies there say they have encountered just such a creature and according to their descriptions, this behemoth is a dead ringer for an Apotosaurus, formerly known as the brontosaurus. Richard speaks with a crypto zoologist and two renowned explorers, one of which who recently led an expedition to the region in hopes a glimpse of this creature. Richard speaks with several journalists and researchers who argue the theory that human use of carbon-based fossil fuels will lead to catastrophic global warming or climate change a “hoax.”

programme.title: Is It Haunted?
programme.desc: Built in the late 17th century Bannockburn house has many links to Scottish history. Bonnie Prince Charlie’s Jacobite army camped within its grounds, while the prince found romance within its walls. Later on it was home to the family responsible for tartan production in Scotland and its sale and distribution across the world. A stone’s throw from the sites of clashes including the Battle of Bannockburn and the Bloody Fauld. Volunteers and workmen are said to have caught fleeting glimpses of shadows and movement while working here. The house presents you with feelings of being watched, silently from within. Reports of knocks, bangs, disconnected voices, apparitions feelings of sickness and sadness have all been documented. It is said by locals that this house is very much alive, it breaths it sleeps and connects with all that enter. Tonight the team will try to uncover its secrets. Welcome to is it haunted?

programme.title: Unsealed: America's Conspiracy Files
programme.desc: Some people think everything is a conspiracy. Luckily for them, the FBI declassified decades' worth of government documents in April 2011, allowing people to gain more insight behind some of the most popular conspiracy theories. Each episode of this series investigates a compelling theory by opening these and other files. After acquiring new information, the show's team of specialists re-examines faulty assumptions, looks for inconsistencies and explores new leads in an attempt to get to the bottom of each case. Just make sure you have your tin foil handy when watching the show.

programme.title: Unsealed: Alien Files
programme.desc: In April 2011 the FBI declassified decades' worth of secret government documents that contain thousands of reports of UFO sightings and alien activity. Each episode of this half-hour series tackles one alien case by investigating the previously off-limits government files. The program re-examines key evidence and follows developing leads based on newly released information. Mass UFO sightings, personal abductions, government cover-ups, and alien news from around the world are some of the topics covered by the show's panel of specialists, who include journalists, researchers, and radio and TV hosts. After watching an episode of "Unsealed: Alien Files," you may begin to believe that "we are not alone."

programme.title: Unsealed: America's Conspiracy Files
programme.desc: Some people think everything is a conspiracy. Luckily for them, the FBI declassified decades' worth of government documents in April 2011, allowing people to gain more insight behind some of the most popular conspiracy theories. Each episode of this series investigates a compelling theory by opening these and other files. After acquiring new information, the show's team of specialists re-examines faulty assumptions, looks for inconsistencies and explores new leads in an attempt to get to the bottom of each case. Just make sure you have your tin foil handy when watching the show.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show
programme.desc: Many believe that there are things in this world that aren't made public that the average person isn't supposed to know about. The truth may be hidden, but there are some people, like host Richard Syrett, who investigate these conspiracies and try to uncover the secrets. "The Conspiracy Show" examines claims of supernatural creatures, political cover-ups, medical discoveries, extraterrestrial life, paranormal phenomena and other unexplained mysteries. Using interviews with top researchers, skeptics, independent thinkers and authors, Syrett is determined to uncover the truth to some of the most extraordinary claims of conspiracy.

programme.desc: 3 wins to come out on top, who's it going to be? Rico Verhoeven, Levi Rigters, Tarik Osaro, Benjamin Adegbuyi, Sofian Laidouni, Uku Jurjendal, Bahram Rajabzadeh, and Nabil Khachab pair up and throw down for the GLORY Heavyweight Grand Prix, an 8-man 1-night heavyweight tournament for the ages.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: The GLORY welterweight title will be on the line in the main event as the reigning & defending champion Endy Semeleer (35-1, 17 KO) welcomes the challenge of top contender Chico Kwasi (42-5, 22 KO). In the co-main event, after his crazy GLORY Heavyweight Grand Prix performance, the wild & exciting Bahram Rajabzadeh (66-2, 58 KO) steps down to light heavyweight and meets the hard-hitting Paris-based Kevin Oumar (33-4, 7 KO), a French kickboxing champion & budding MMA star. Belgian-Moroccan superstar Youssef Boughanem (187-43-8, 119 KO) steps into the GLORY ring for the very first time in his illustrious career as he meets the Ukraine’s Stanislav Kazantsev (25-8-1, 7 KO). The best of French kickboxing will be on display throughout the rest of the card as a host of the nation’s top stars will be in action against opponents from all over the world.

programme.title: Bassmaster
programme.sub-title: 2022 Spawning Bass Recap: Santee Cooper & Chickamauga
programme.desc: The year long points race on the Bassmaster Elite Series culminates at the final event of the season in Wisconsin. Watch Brandon Palaniuk end his history making season.

programme.title: Bassmaster
programme.desc: Every year the best semi-pro fishermen in the world compete in the Bassmaster Opens in hopes of qualifying for the Bassmaster Elite Series professional tour and for the biggest event in the sport the Bassmaster Classic.

programme.title: Bassmaster
programme.sub-title: 2022 Smallmouth Swing Recap: St. Lawrence & Oahe
programme.desc: Competitive bass fishing has spread through the collegiate ranks at a rapid pace. The Bassmaster College Series Classic Bracket features the best anglers for 2022 who hope to graduate to the next level of professional fishing.

programme.title: Bassmaster
programme.desc: Winning the Bassmaster Classic is a life-changing accomplishment for professional fishermen. See the final moments of the 2022 Classic as each angler gets one step closer to victory.

programme.title: Tackle Tip - Brandon Palaniuk
programme.desc: One of the best structure fishermen in the world Brandon Palaniuk talks about isolated structure in the fall season. BP also gives a few bait suggestions including his handy dropshot.

programme.title: Bassmaster
programme.desc: Breaking the 100 pound mark for four days is a revered achievement in professional fishing. That happened for eight different anglers in 2022. Go in the boat with each angler as they accomplish this feat.

programme.title: Tackle Tip - Kenta Kimura
programme.desc: Kenta Kimura gives some suggestions to be better with the Megabass Magdraft swimbait. He changes the treble to his signature Ryugi quad-hook design for better hookups and he also adds a split ring to the line tie for increased head action and roll. Those two things are essential for Kimura along with finding the right speed on retrieve.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Jason Christie Classic
programme.desc: A story a decade in the making unfolded at the 2022 Bassmaster Classic when ‪@Christiefishing‬ notched his first Classic victory at Lake Hartwell. Watch Christie's Marathon Peak Performance from start to finish as he climbed the mountain in the sport of bass fishing and achieved the biggest win in the sport.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Brock Mosley
programme.desc: In his 8-year Bassmaster Elite Series career, Brock Mosley has been so close to major titles but fallen just short with 5 2nd place finishes and even more Top 10’s. Watch Mosley put four great days together on his way to his first Elite Series title at the 2023 Folds of Honor Bassmaster Elite at the Sabine River and take home the Marathon Peak Performance!

programme.title: Peak Performance - Bryant Schmitt
programme.desc: Bryan Schmitt is one of the winningest anglers in professional fishing and his great track record is noted on grassy river fisheries. Schmitt ended 2022 with a big victory on the Mighty Mississippi River in La Crosse, Wisconsin. Watch his stellar week in the Marathon Peak Performance of the tournament.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Kyoya Fujitia
programme.desc: In the Marathon Peak Performance for the 8th stop of the 2023 Bassmaster Elite Series season, watch Kyoya Fujita take the title at Lake Champlain for the first B.A.S.S. win of his career. The young Japanese prodigy stormed to 5 Top 10's in his Rookie season.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Joey Cifuentes
programme.desc: First year Bassmaster Elite Series pro Joey Cifuentes dominated the Lake Seminole Elite event and took his first pro-level victory. Cifuentes outlasted the field with a four-day total of 85 pounds, 2 ounces. In this Marathon Peak Performance you can watch his winning week.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Trey Mckinney
programme.desc: One week after turning 19 years old, Trey McKinney became the youngest Bassmaster Elite Series Champion after landing 130 pounds, 15 ounces at Lake Fork for the 2nd stop of the season. Watch his week unfold in this Marathon Peak Performance feature.

programme.title: Peak Performance - John Garrett
programme.desc: The Marathon Peak Performance for the third stop of the Elite Series season features John Garrett and his impressive week at the Harris Chain of Lakes. The former College Champion and current Elite Series rookie led wire to wire and got his first blue trophy in just his 3rd event of the season.

programme.title: Peak Performance - CliffPrince
programme.desc: Watch Cliff Prince's winning week at Wheeler Lake in this edition of the Marathon Peak Performance of the tournament. Prince found a magical spot where the fishing was on fire the first two hours of every tournament day and it lasted all four days en route to his first blue trophy on the Bassmaster Elite Series. The area was 4 to 5 feet deep and Prince maintained a low profile and fished his chatterbait around grass and over a hard spot without using his forward facing sonar.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Drew Benton
programme.desc: In the Marathon Peak Performance at the 2023 Lake Murray Bassmaster Elite Series, watch Drew Benton's tournament as he notched his 2nd Bassmaster victory. Benton started the week in 2nd place, jumped into the lead, fell to 10th and then completed a comeback of over 5 pounds on the Final Day to win.

programme.title: Peak Performance - LukePalmer
programme.desc: Bassmaster Elite Series pro Luke Palmer has been dubbed as one of the most consistent pros early in his career. His first four years all found him in the 20’s for Angler of the Year and while he’s shown signs of his ability, wins have eluded him. At Santee Cooper he has his Marathon Peak Performance as he follows up a 4th last year, with a win in South Carolina in 2023.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Buddy Gross
programme.desc: The Marathon Peak Performance at the Harris Chain of Lakes went to Buddy Gross who came from behind to win his second career Bassmaster Elite Series event. Watch Gross go to work and win big in Florida.

programme.title: Peak Performance - John Crews
programme.desc: The Marathon Peak Performance at the St. Johns River went to ‪@JohnCrews‬ as he led wire to wire to win his second career Bassmaster Elite Series event. Watch his week from behind the lens as he strived for another major tournament victory as a professional fisherman.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Jason Christie
programme.desc: Jason Christie led three days of the Elite Series event at the Sabine River and rode a great two days of fishing to the winners circle in his return year to the Bassmaster Elites. He is the Marathon Peak Performance at the Sabine.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Joey Cifuentes
programme.desc: In the Marathon Peak Performance at the 7th stop of the 2023 Bassmaster Elite Series season, Joey Cifuentes takes the title at Lake St. Clair by going against the grain. Cowboy Cifuentes is a Rookie on the Elite Series but with two wins in 2023, he has wowed the fishing world.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Austin Felix
programme.desc: Austin Felix had an impeccable smallmouth record in Bassmaster Elite Series events prior to Lake Oahe, but the Minnesota pro went to another level after four successful days in South Dakota. In the Marathon Peak Performance at Lake Oahe, watch Austin Felix take home his first tour-level victory with Bassmaster.

programme.title: Peak Performance -Patrick Walters
programme.desc: In the Marathon Peak Performance at the St. Lawrence River, watch as Patrick Walters wins his 2nd Elite Series victory and breaks the 100-pound mark for the 3rd time in his career.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Brandon Lester
programme.desc: ‪@BrandonLesterFishing‬ fished a flawless week at Pickwick Lake for the 6th stop of the 2022 Bassmaster Elite Series season. Lester took the title and won his first Elite Series title and his second B.A.S.S. win this year. Congratulations to Lester, the Marathon Peak Performance at Pickwick.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Tyler Rivet
programme.desc: In the Marathon Peak Performance from Lake Okeechobee, follow Tyler Rivet as he closes in on his first Bassmaster Elite Series title. Rivet is a 5th year Elite Series pro who started his career in college at Nicholls State where he formed a Bass Team and fished in every Bassmaster National Championship during his five years in school.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Drew Cook
programme.desc: Bassmaster Elite Series pro Drew Cook (‪@thecutlinetv‬) has been a strong competitor since joining the Elite Series in 2019, but a win has eluded him early in his career.

programme.title: Peak Performance -Patrick Walters
programme.desc: Through just 5 years on the Bassmaster Elite Series, Patrick Walters has an incredible resume. He added another accolade with a win at Lake Murray, doing so in impressive fashion. Congratulations to ‪@patrickwaltersfishing5121‬, he is the Marathon Peak Performance at the 5th stop of the 2024 season.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Lee Livesay
programme.desc: Walk on the wild side with Lee Livesay and his entire week at Lake Fork as he looked to go back to back on his home lake. Livesay was the local favorite with the most amount of knowledge at Lake Fork, but sometimes that can bite you. In the Marathon Peak Performance of the Event, Livesay wins his third Elite Series title and fourth overall Bassmaster victory in just a span of 18 months.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Justin Hammer
programme.desc: ‪@justinhamnerfishing‬ followed his passion and that dream led him to the Bassmaster Elite Series. After a few years on the Elites, he was in the catbird seat of the 2024 Bassmaster Classic where his lifelong dream came true and he became the World Champion of bass fishing. Watch his week unfold at Grand Lake O' the Cherokees in Oklahoma.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Jeff Gustafson
programme.desc: In the Marathon Peak Performance at the 2023 Bassmaster Classic, watch Jeff Gustafson's dominant performance as he wins for the second time on Fort Loudoun and Tellico. Gussy started strong with 18-8 and 17-3 over Day 1 and 2, but on the final day he needed every bit of his lead to hold off the hard-charging field of anglers looking to make up weight and try to win the Bassmaster Classic

programme.title: Peak Performance - Will Davis Jr.
programme.desc: In his Marathon Peak Performance of the week, watch Will Davis Jr. win his first Bassmaster Elite Series title in dramatic fashion on his home body of water. Davis won by just 2 ounces over Brandon Palaniuk, making it the closest margin of victory since Toledo Bend of 2011.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Takumi Ito
programme.desc: Taku Ito got another blue trophy on the Bassmaster Elite Series with his big win at Smith Lake. Relive his week in Alabama where he conquered spotted bass en route to his second Elite Series win since joining the top ranks in 2020.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Ed Loughran III
programme.desc: Ed Loughran, who is also a practicing attorney, notched his biggest fishing achievement by winning the Bassmaster Elite Series event at Lake Champlain. He leaned on both largemouth and smallmouth en route to his first career victory. He is the Marathon Peak Performance for the 8th event of the 2024 Elite Series season.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Jay Przekurat
programme.desc: As a 23-year old rookie on the Bassmaster Elite Series, Jay Przekurat made history. programme.title: And the Crows Will Dig Your Grave
programme.desc: After the Civil War, Wells Fargo hires gunmen to protect against increasing bandit attacks. Jeff Sullivan, driven by revenge for his murdered wife, joins the team to hunt down Glenn Kovacks and his gang. Alongside bounty hunter Pancho Corrales, Sullivan faces treachery, culminating in a deadly showdown where only he survives to save a prisoner.

programme.title: The White, the Yellow and the Black
programme.desc: In the 19th century, when the Japanese Emperor sends a gift pony to the US President it gets stolen and ransomed by Indians but Sheriff Gideon aided by an inept Japanese servant offers to deliver the ransom.

programme.title: Rattler Kid
programme.desc: Falsely convicted for robbing an army treasury, Tony Garrett escapes prison and sets out to find the real criminals responsible. As he hunts for revenge, he faces dangers and uncovers dark truths, determined to clear his name and make the true culprits pay for their actions.

programme.title: Days of Violence
programme.desc: In the final months of the Civil War, Joe’s brother is unjustly slain by a Northern captain. Consumed by grief and fury, Joe joins a band of Southern fighters who refuse to surrender, seeking justice and redemption amid the dying embers of war.

programme.title: Don't Wait, Django... Shoot!
programme.desc: Django returns home to discover that his father has been killed by local bandits in a business deal gone wrong.

programme.title: Django Meets Sartana
programme.desc: The small desert town of Black City is held in a reign of terror by a nasty gang of criminals lead by the ruthless Bud Willer.

programme.title: Deadly Trackers
programme.desc: Jeff sets out to murder each one of the five outlaws who robbed, raped and killed his poor sister.

programme.title: His Name was King
programme.desc: A relentless bounty hunter pursues a brutal gang of gunrunners deep into Mexico. As he crosses the lawless borderlands, he’s drawn into a deadly chase where justice and vengeance blur in the desert heat.

programme.title: Dead are Countless
programme.desc: As a child, Johnny witnessed his father’s death at the hands of soldiers. Now an outlaw, he seeks revenge by killing soldiers whenever possible. Lieutenant Garringo is tasked with capturing Johnny and bringing him back alive. A dangerous game of cat and mouse ensues, with Garringo determined to fulfill his mission.

programme.title: The Shooting
programme.desc: A mysterious woman persuades two cowboys to help her in a revenge scheme.

programme.title: One Dollar Too Many
programme.desc: Suave gambler Clay Watson, cocky sharpshooter Moses Lang, and wily thespian Edwin Kean are a trio of criminals in the Old West.

programme.title: Dynamite Joe
programme.desc: Agent Joe Ford, nicknamed “Dynamite Joe” for his explosive methods, is assigned to escort a vital gold shipment after a string of deadly ambushes threatens U.S. finances. With danger at every turn, Joe’s skills and dynamite are the last hope to stop the outlaws behind the attacks.

programme.title: Trinity and Sartana Are Coming
programme.desc: Sartana and Trinity set out on a grudging relationship hell bent for gold and comic brawls.

programme.title: Man Who Cried for Revenge
programme.desc: Davy Flanagan, a former Union officer who was part of an attempt to break out of a Confederate prison camp during the Civil War and suffered a blow to the head that left him with amnesia. Then a bounty hunter shows up to collect a bounty on his head as a deserter.

programme.title: A Pistol for Django
programme.desc: When Django’s fiancée is kidnapped by the ruthless Cortez brothers after a bank robbery, he joins forces with an American ally and agent Fulton, who’s tasked with recovering the stolen gold. Together, they face the gang hiding in a remote cave for a perilous rescue and revenge mission.

programme.title: Poker in bed
programme.desc: Love, rivalry, and high-stakes games mix in a witty tale of ambition and seduction

programme.title: Hitch-Hike
programme.desc: Walter and Eve, a young married couple in crisis, set off on a trip through the California woods in an attempt to save their marriage. On the way back, the two offer a hitchhiker a lift: he is a bandit on the run, fresh from a bank robbery, but by the time the couple realise the situation, it is already too late.

programme.title: White Apache
programme.desc: Outlaws attack a band of settlers and kill everyone except a pregnant woman who's rescued by a band of Indians. The woman dies giving birth but Chief White Bear adopts her male baby, naming him "Shining Sky," and raising him as brother to his own son, Black Wolf.

programme.title: Hen Party
programme.desc: Five women meet to celebrate the hen night of one of them. It is the bride who has organised everything, but she is not there and leaves clues that lead the four bridesmaids across the eternal city to their old high school. In the meantime, the friends have talked, discussed, argued, tackled the most diverse topics. Until the final big surprise.

programme.title: Lady Frankenstein
programme.desc: Frankenstein's daughter and her lover resurrect his work after his first monster kills him.

programme.title: Thieves and Robbers
programme.desc: A playboy who makes a living out of seducing women and stealing their jewellery accidentally witnesses a Mafia murder. He must work together with the man who is constantly trying to catch him, Lt. Alan Parker, in order to save his life.

programme.title: Django Kill... If You Live, Shoot!
programme.desc: A gritty western thriller where a lawman embarks on a mission to seek revenge in a lawless town.

programme.title: Dead Uncle

When he meets a stranger after leaving his bachelor's party early, things take an unexpected turn as disaster strikes.

Forced to trade his bachelor antics for a life of commitment, Jordan scrambles to find the perfect partner but soon realises that love, and marriage, isn’t as simple as sealing a deal.

programme.desc: Bennie, a mother of three, knows her time is near after months of keeping her ovarian cancer a secret. To test her husband’s ability to take care of their children when she’s gone, she disappears without a trace, leaving him alone to cater for the children.

Determined to get his life back, he starts a lowly job that leads him to a young woman, who feels sorry for him and decides to help him get all he has lost.

programme.title: Obsession
programme.desc: Jealousy rears its ugly head and puts a couple's relationship in jeopardy when they invite guests to stay over in their home.

Vishal brings her into his lavish house and makes sure that she's well taken care of. In the same house, she meets Vishal's arrogant brother, Sagar (Govinda) who gets annoyed by her presence. But they get over their initial dislike of each other and fall in love. Problem arises when Vishal too begins to like Barkha and plans to marry her. How will he react when he finds out the truth?

programme.title: Best of Morning Footy
programme.desc: CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK is a first-of-its-kind free, 24-hour channel in the U.S.dedicated exclusively to global soccer coverage. CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK, with its unparalleled coverage of all the top domestic and international soccer competitions across the globe, is the ultimate year-round streaming destination for soccer fans. CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK is anchored weekdays from 7:00-9:00 AM, ET, by - MORNING FOOTY, the Network’s flagship morning show. Every weekday, MORNING FOOTY host Susannah Collins along with former U.S. Men’s National Team player Charlie Davies, analyst Nico Cantor and comedian Alexis Guerreros bring their unique voices and fresh perspectives to the latest news and storylines impacting soccer worldwide. As soccer’s new staple show for fans everywhere, MORNING FOOTY delivers a daily dose of razor-sharp insights and laughs with match highlights, compelling analysis, entertaining interviews, updates - from reporter Jenny Chiu and more that is sure to help kick off your day. In addition, the Network will feature live matches, pre- and post-match breakdowns, magazine shows, films from Paramount+’s STORIES FROM THE BEAUTIFUL GAME soccer documentary collection and original programming. The Network’s live matches and re-airs utilize CBS Sports’ collection of top-tier soccer properties, including UEFA club competitions, Serie A, NWSL, Concacaf national team competitions, Barclays Women’s Super League, Campeonato Brasileirão Série A, Scottish Professional Football League, Argentina Liga Profesional de Fútbol and the AFC Champions League, among others. Watch CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK 24 hours a day, 7 days a week and all 365 days a year.

programme.title: Rimac Concept One

programme.title: Bentley Bentayga
programme.desc: With the Bentley Bentayga, the traditional British brand is entering the fastest growing market segment. This world's first luxury SUV is a conglomerate of superlatives on wheels.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: Since the 1950s, the Mercedes-Benz SL has been regarded as the sports car legend par excellence. Beginning with the legendary 300 SL with its gullwing doors, the SL series stands for innovation and cultivated sportiness.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: The Ford Mustang is the icon of all sports coupes and convertibles - no other car conveys so much the lifestyle of the 1960s. With its striking shape and powerful engines the Mustang drove itself into the hearts of millions.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: The Beatles, Peter Sellers, Britt Ekland or the British royals, they all drove the Austin Mini. Designed on a napkin, the Mini starts an incredible career in 1959: the revolutionary Mini is considered the prototype of all small cars.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: A car that everyone knows and that almost everyone has ridden in, a car that has conquered all continents and bears an unmistakable nickname, the Volkswagen Beetle.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: Ferrari - the name alone raises the pulse. No other sports car has as much magic and myth as the fiery red icons from Maranello. Whether on the road or on the race track, these cars are the centre of attention.

programme.title: Facel Vega Facellia
programme.desc: In the late 1950s, the Facel Vega Facellia was designed to compete with Porsche and Alfa Romeo and open a new market segment for the fledgling French luxury car company.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: The RM Auction Company has worked with Dale before as a buyer, seller, historian, and caretaker at the prestigious Lee Hartung auction. But this event is no last minute rush to define one man’s treasures. This is a well calculated, time consuming, multi-media, and multi motorcycle and prized art deal.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?
programme.desc: Home Depot Senior Vice President, Gordon Erickson, is a huge fan of Wheels Through Time. He is also a huge supporter of the Wounded Warrior program. For years the hardware giant has been donating goods and services to help returning servicemen with their fix-it-up projects. Now they would like to go one step further and build a WWII military bike to raise awareness and funds. Only problem is where to get one? Enter Dale and an exhaustive, time sensitive, cross country search for a rare military machine.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: In this episode, Ray celebrates the 50th birthday of the Ford Mustang through the lens of three distinct Mustang owners, who each hold a slice of the car’s incredible history. In 1964, Chicago schoolteacher Gail Wise unknowingly purchased the first ever Mustang 3 days before the car became available to the general public. Her husband reveals the incredible restoration that brought the earliest Mustang ever sold back to its 60’s glory. (Ford Motor Company knows she has the car and has verified it was sold before it was legal to sell.) John Grafelman is a farmer in Illinois and life-long Ford lover. A few years ago he found an old car hidden in a barn. It took some time, but he eventually convinced his friend to sell it to him. After some detective work, he discovers he purchased 1968 Ford Design Chief Larry Shinoda’s personal car that he tinkered with to invent the BOSS 302.Lastly, Ray travels to Dayton Ohio to interview Gale Holderman, the Ford stylist who won the company’s contest to draw and design the Mustang.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Post-World War II, a large generation of American soldiers was looking for cars that mirrored the incredible sports cars they saw overseas in Europe. After searching for an affordable way to recreate these cars, one manufacturer responded with a durable, cost effective option: a line of fiberglass sports cars. Very few of these cars still exist but there are collectors who are constantly looking to save parts and pieces of these virtually unknown vehicles. We learn about these rare cars from Geoff Hacker and his team at Forgotten Fiberglass, and take a visit to the Smithsonian Museum, which houses a fiberglass car of its own. This episode presents a unique look at how the narrative of American wartime experiences often shaped the nation’s automotive demands.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Ray explores buying a unique, hand built car the Schultz family has kept in their New Jersey home for years. The car was originally called the Schultz El Fierro but it’s officially titled in New Jersey as a “Schultz Special” from 1958. It was used to drag race and held numerous racing records, but most important to the family was that it was driven by the legendary Carroll Shelby. With a frame and style much similar to the Shelby Roadster, the Schultz family wonders if it inspired one of the most well known automobiles in America. In another epic New Jersey story, Ray finds Mario Andretti’s 1965 IndyCar. The catch: it’s completely in pieces hidden away in a garage. The iconic driver talks about his days on the track with that car and Ray attempts to negotiate a deal to buy the parts.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: How do you cast a car in a movie? What are the secrets to the build? Hollywood car designers give Ray the ultimate tour of some memorable movie cars, including a look at the recently found “Hells Chariot”, the last surviving car from Grease. We also hear the backstory to “Bumble Bee” from Transformers, take a look at the making of the tanks for Hunger Games and stumble upon the iconic 1958 Chevy Impala from American Graffiti.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: While visiting the estate of automotive genius and land speed record holder Willie Glass, Ray uncovers a set of extremely rare Ardun cylinder heads, which is a hot rodders dream discovery. He also visits the infamous H & H Flatheads outside of Los Angeles and discovers a surprise connection to the Earnhardt family.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: A massive sinkhole opened underneath the National Corvette Museum in Kentucky. Eight amazing cars were swallowed up, including the 1,000,000th Corvette. AmeriCarna was given exclusive access to document the removal of the cars from the sinkhole and the painstaking restoration of the 1,000,000th Corvette.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: On the beaches of Wildwood, NJ, an iconic vintage race, The Race of Gentleman, takes place annually: period cars, period dress, pure authenticity. Ray puts a car in the race with a very special driver, who turns out not to be a Gentleman.

programme.title: What's In the Barn?

programme.desc: For Dale and Matt sometimes the dotted line to treasure splits and heads in opposite directions. In this edition of What’s in the Barn, time is thrust to the forefront of this multi-state, long distance, north, south search. Timeless and priceless 110 year old bikes, antique cars, airplanes, and the infamous Egberts 1930 neon Harley-Davidson sign that coined the phrase “Ride a Winner” are high on this father and son’s list of “must haves”. programme.title: The Ed Sullivan Show
programme.desc: "The Ed Sullivan Show" is TV's longest-running variety show. It ran on Sunday nights for an amazing 23 years. The show's host, Ed Sullivan, had been a syndicated newspaper columnist who hosted two radio shows before agreeing to try television. On camera, Sullivan always seemed nervous and ill at ease; he couldn't sing or dance, but he knew people who could and signed them to appear each week. Called "Toast of the Town" until 1955, "The Ed Sullivan Show" featured the TV debuts of artists such as Irving Berlin, Hedy Lamarr, Walt Disney, and Fred Astaire and Jane Powell. The format of the show changed very little over the years, with Sullivan presenting acts that tried to please everyone. A typical show might include a few comics, an aria performed by an opera diva, an acrobat and maybe a plug for a new film from a well-known movie star.

She also explores Merlin's Cave and meets a life coach named Euan in St Neot. Marilia engages in nature bathing and encounters wildlife while walking towards Muir. At Joe's home and studio, she assists him in painting and enjoys his vinyl covers and guitar music. Marilia learns about animal massage therapy from Jenna and goes on a carriage ride through rural scenery. She joins the Seaweeders for seaweed foraging, visits the drying warehouse, and meets Gemma, an Alexander Technique specialist. Marilia also takes time to relax at a hotel spa, filming her show against the stunning ocean cliff. This episode offers a captivating exploration of Cornwall's landscapes, encounters with talented individuals, and immersive experiences.

programme.title: Art Wolfe’s Travels to the Edge
programme.desc: Located in the heart of South America, the Pantanal is the world’s largest wetland and home to one of the densest concentrations of wildlife on the planet. It’s a unique place where human activity and wildlife coexist. Here Brazilian cowboys ride herd alongside toothy caimans, giant otters, capybaras, macaws and toucans. In episode five, Art Wolfe arrives just as the seasonal floods have receded and discovers both an ecological paradise and a vibrant cowboy culture.

programme.title: Toque 12

programme.title: Isles of the Queen
programme.desc: In Old-Norse, its name means Isle of Cloud, or Misty Isle. Legend says that God boasted of its beauty. The Isle of Skye embodies everything that makes Scotland unique. In the past, life in this inhospitable place was difficult. Since then much has changed, not least thanks to the bridge linking it to the mainldn. The island is now home to many artists and creatives.

programme.title: Grand Earth
programme.sub-title: Deserts: Salt Desert, Bolivia; Socotra, Yemen
programme.desc: When most people think of deserts, we think of punishing heat, camels and rattlesnakes. But dig a little deeper, and unbelievable stories emerge, like a bleeding tree, and a desert filled with salt.

programme.title: The World Is Yours
programme.desc: In this episode we will travel to Paris and visit the Louvre, one of the most important museums in the world, we will cross the Seine River in an incredible journey through its waters and under its bridges in the Batobus, and finally we will climb to the top of the most emblematic building of Paris: the Eiffel Tower. Then we will go to a true natural paradise, the exotic islands of Hawaii, where we will discover the famous Hawaiian volcanoes, and travel in time to the beginning of the Second World War when visiting the Pearl Harbor Museum. To round things up we will learn why Hawaii is the favorite destination for the surfers and for lovers of water sports of all kinds. As if all that were not enough, we will visit Rio de Janeiro in Brazil, where we will enjoy the famous Beaches of Ipanema and Copacabana, and ascend to the top of Corcovado Hill to embrace the "Christ the Redeemer", and top it all off we will experience the biggest party of all Latin America:" The Carnival of Rio ".

To round things up we will learn why Hawaii is the favorite destination for the surfers and for lovers of water sports of all kinds. As if all that were not enough, we will visit Rio de Janeiro in Brazil, where we will enjoy the famous Beaches of Ipanema and Copacabana, and ascend to the top of Corcovado Hill to embrace the "Christ the Redeemer", and top it all off we will experience the biggest party of all Latin America:" The Carnival of Rio ".

programme.title: Salvador de Mujeres
programme.sub-title: Episodio 42: Salvador y Fernando se averg enzan.
programme.desc: Charo le grita toda la verdad a la familia. Unos le creen y otros no. Josefina se ve muy triste al escuchar todos los insultos que ella dice. Socorro pelea con Charo y Josefina se involucra tratando de evitar un desastre. Charo le recalca lo mucho que la odia y se va. Socorro se queda consolando a su madre. Fernando va a trabajar como amante pago y recibe una llamada de Gonzalo, quien le dice que se marche de su cita pues lo reemplazar otro hombre. Quien llega es Salvador y al verse, los dos se averg enzan. Salvador atiende a la mujer y Fernando sigue su camino.

programme.title: Engañada
programme.sub-title: Enganada - Episodio 42: Celos, Confrontaci n y un Reconocimiento Inesperado
programme.desc: A su llegada a la casa de Marisela, Gabriel retarda la partida de la esposa de Jes s al hablarle a esta de amor sin recordar la supuesta gravedad de su paciente, Jes s se deja invadir por los celos y la desesperaci n al ver a Marisela en compa a de Gabriel y esperar su llegada para amenazarlos a ambos de muerte. Abril llora su angustia en el mismo lugar donde acontecieron los hechos de su pasada violaci n, d ndole as oportunidad a Reinaldo de reconocer en ella a la victimizada muchacha que en el pasado lo lleno de preocupaci n, Abril se encarga de evadir a Reinaldo al mostrarse interesada en no ser reconocida por el que ella cree a uno de sus atacantes.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio 85: Dileidy Pasante, Sorpresa para Luis Fernando
programme.desc: Tatianita al ver a su padre se pone llorosa le hace recordar cuando sus amigas del colegio la hac an llorar por lo de su padre. La nena le dice que no las comprar n con ropa nueva. Aristigueta le dice a la nena que vino por ella que vino a quedarse. La nena llora. Aristigueta se va y se consigue abajo a Doroteo quien estaba por all admirando su carro dispuesto a ir donde la nena. Aristigueta abrumado le regala una botella que le hab a dado la nena. Doroteo sube a ver a la nena y la encuentra abrumada, la nena le pide que no le pregunte nada y que la abrace. Gladis le da esperanzas a gabito que ellos dos pudieran tener algo pero no le concreta nada. Ram n y Gonzalo le hablan a marco que cuidado con Gladis porque le puede resultar una cuaima. Pascuita le pide a Ram n como regalo de navidad tener un var n. A ramon no parece gustarle mucho la idea. Por su parte Gonzalo le pide a Matilde que como regalo de navidad que se case con l. A Matilde no parece gustarle tampoco mucho la idea. La novia de Luis Fernando le comenta que tatianita le hab a comentado que no sabia por qu ellos habian terminado que podr an volver. Luis Fernando sabe que es como si dileidy le hablara que lo hace para olvidarse de ella. Gabriel le comenta a aureliano que Gladis parece darle esperanzas, aureliano por su parte le comenta a Gabriel que fue al cine con dileidy. Ambos brindan porque andan bien cada quien con la suya. Gladis le da la sorpresa a dileidy que le consigui una pasantia para que se olvide de Luis Fernando. Egl e por su parte le comenta a Luis Fernando que marco le asign un proyecto para un centro comercial y le comenta que espera que se olvide de su despecho por dileidy. Yennilu feliz porque su amiga dileidy consigui pasantia y esta echando para adelante. Dileidy piensa conseguirle a ella tambi n trabajo all . Santiago le comenta a Eglee que ahora con ese proyecto para el centro comercial podr verla mas a ella. R mulo le comenta a betzaida que c mo es posible que santiago pretenda a Eglee. Betzaida se molesta porque R mulo esta celoso de egl e. Felicita le comenta a Gladis que ella no es de estar estudiando sino que sirve es para querer a Luis Fernando. Gladis le comenta que mejor se supere como mujer y no dependa de un hombre para ser feliz. Luis Fernando y santiago llegan a la oficina de marco, ste le presenta a la nueva pasante, cual es la sorpresa de Luis Fernando ver a dileidy como la nueva pasante.

programme.title: Cuando Hay Pasión
programme.sub-title: Cuando Hay Pasion - Episodio 30: Robert le pide matrimonio a In s
programme.desc: Luis Guillermo al ser advertido por Daniela sobre las intenciones de Robert esp a a este pidiendo a In s en matrimonio. Marisela tras ser descubierta por Bertha disimula ante ella al haber llamado a Diego Andr s. Daniela conversa con Luis Guillermo proponi ndole a este una reconciliaci n a pesar de la oposici n de su padre. In s sinti ndose sorprendida por la propuesta de Robert guarda silencio mientras este le declara su amor. Daniela se encarga de convencer a Luis Guillermo quien se muestra disperso al saber a Robert dispuesto a casarse con In s. Armando conversa con Flavia quien se muestra preocupada por los sentimientos de Robert, Armando percatado de la actitud de su hijo le explica a Flavia cu les son sus intenciones con In s.

programme.title: Mundo de Fieras
programme.desc: Rosario Flores, conocida por todos como "Charito", es una muchacha buena y hermosa que vive sola en el campo con su madre, Mar a Antonieta. El padre de Charito, Leoncio Palacios, las abandon a las dos mucho tiempo atr s para irse con su nueva esposa, Miriam. La salud de Mar a Antonieta empeora, por lo que le pide a Leoncio, que tambi n tiene una hija llamada Joselyn, que cuide de Charito. Joselyn Palacios, que sufre problemas mentales, en realidad no es hija de Leoncio, sino de una relaci n extraconyugal de Miriam con otro hombre, Federico Ansola. Mar a Antonieta fallece despu s de un tiempo y su hija queda totalmente sola. Por suerte para ella, Chabela Soriano, una vieja amiga de su madre, la hospeda en su casa junto a sus dos hijos.

programme.title: La Viuda Joven
programme.desc: Vicenta se cans de que Federico no le crea y le da los anillos de compromiso y de matrimonio y le dice que todo entre ellos termin , porque es una carga para ella. Federico arma sus valijas para irse de su casa y le dice a Vicenta, que no puede vivir bajo el mismo techo que una delincuente, porque ella, estuvo presa, despu s secuestr a Jos Guillermo de los brazos de la familia temporal y luego se cas con Christian, para volver otra vez a adoptarlo, enga a un juez, y para terminar, le miente diciendo que el hijo que tuvieron es de un hombre al que no conocen; pero Federico va a hablar con Christian quien le confirma que , es el padre del hijo que Vicenta tuvo y que lo concibieron por inseminaci n artificial.

programme.desc: Tatianita al ver a su padre se pone llorosa le hace recordar cuando sus amigas del colegio la hac an llorar por lo de su padre. La nena le dice que no las comprar n con ropa nueva. programme.title: La Cacería: Las Niñas de Alto Hospicio
programme.sub-title: La Caceria: Las Ninas de Alto Hospicio - 72 Hours
programme.desc: El capitán Rojas llega al norte de Chile desde Santiago para investigar la misteriosa desaparición de un grupo de adolescentes en Alto Hospicio. Carrasco, un oficial de policía local asignado como su compañero, intenta explicarle la teoría oficial: las jóvenes huyeron de sus vidas infernales para prostituirse en el extranjero. La investigación de Rojas, combinada con la desaparición de la hija de un pescador local, revela una verdad más perturbadora. Rojas está convencido de que las chicas fueron secuestradas o asesinadas.

programme.title: La Cacería: Las Niñas de Alto Hospicio
programme.sub-title: La Caceria: Las Ninas de Alto Hospicio - Tacna
programme.desc: Información de inteligencia confirmada por el jefe de la policía de Alto Hospicio obliga a Rojas y Carrasco a viajar a Tacna, una ciudad peruana salvaje en la frontera con Chile. En Perú, Rojas se infiltra en las bandas de trata de personas que comercian con “esclavas blancas” en un intento por encontrar a las chicas chilenas desaparecidas, sin éxito. Después de que Carrasco lo rescata de una muerte segura en un club en Perú, regresa a Chile con una nueva teoría: hay un asesino en serie en Alto Hospicio.

programme.title: La Cacería: Las Niñas de Alto Hospicio
programme.sub-title: La Caceria: Las Ninas de Alto Hospicio - La Primera Victima
programme.desc: Tras revisar todos los asesinatos de mujeres en la zona, el capitán Rojas cree haber encontrado el "caso cero" de su asesino en serie: una prostituta cuyo cuerpo apareció en una playa hace dos años. Mientras Rojas sigue esta pista, Carrasco sospecha de un profesor de voleibol que enseñó a varias de las chicas desaparecidas. La información se difunde entre los vecinos, que quieren hacer justicia por su cuenta.

programme.title: La Cacería: Las Niñas de Alto Hospicio
programme.sub-title: La Caceria: Las Ninas de Alto Hospicio - Los Perros
programme.desc: Rojas sale del hospital tras recibir una brutal paliza en la que Carrasco también participó en secreto. El intento de intimidarlo solo refuerza su necesidad de seguir investigando, pero su teoría se desmorona cuando se prueba la inocencia del conductor de La Ponderosa, a quien consideraba el principal sospechoso. Paralelamente, Andrea investiga el pasado de Rojas y una amenaza contra su hijo Diego lleva al capitán al límite.

programme.title: La Cacería: Las Niñas de Alto Hospicio
programme.sub-title: La Caceria: Las Ninas de Alto Hospicio - Todas las Familias
programme.desc: Después de exponer la corrupción y amenazar a su superior, Rojas continúa su investigación sin el apoyo de la policía. Una nueva pista lo lleva a investigar un secreto dentro de la familia Ávila. Andrea gana la confianza de la hermana de Valeria Ávila, cuyo testimonio los acerca a la verdadera identidad del asesino. Ayleen intenta reencauzar su vida, sin saber el peligro que eso conlleva, ya que el psicópata de Alto Hospicio busca una nueva víctima.

programme.title: La Cacería: Las Niñas de Alto Hospicio
programme.sub-title: La Caceria: Las Ninas de Alto Hospicio - El Pozo
programme.desc: Rojas está convencido de haber descubierto la identidad del psicópata, pero no tiene pruebas. Viaja al pueblo natal del asesino, donde descubre el origen de sus instintos violentos. Ayleen sobrevive a un brutal ataque y su testimonio se convierte en la clave para encontrar al psicópata. Rojas y Carrasco deben unir fuerzas nuevamente para quebrar al asesino y obtener la confesión que necesitan. Finalmente, Rojas se enfrenta cara a cara con el psicópata de Alto Hospicio.

programme.title: Texas Lady
programme.desc: Una mujer de cabeza fuerte del Este hereda un periódico en un pequeño pueblo de Texas donde los barones del ganado locales, que controlan la región, quieren quitársela de encima.

programme.title: El niño y el potro
programme.desc: En un pueblo de Galicia vive trabajando la tierra un hombre joven, Andrés, que quedó viudo con la única compañía de su hijo, Andresiño. En la doma de caballos salvajes, Fuco es competidor de Andrés, y quiere ante éste lucir su fuerza para ganarse la admiración de Ana, la joven maestra del pueblo. Tampoco Andrés oculta su admiración por la maestra de Andresiño. Hay otro "personaje" en la historia, Benito, gracioso potrillo del que Andresiño procura no separarse nunca. Fuco se muestra resentido porque Andrés y la maestra han iniciado una relación muy cordial, que se hace cada día más frecuente. Ana tiene, además como alumno más aventajado, a Andresiño.

programme.title: Bienvenido, padre Murray
programme.desc: El padre Murray llega a Valley City, en la frontera con México; allí debe velar por la observancia de la moral, que últimamente está en decadencia. Sin embargo, como es un hombre negro, esto provoca la irritación de los habitantes del pueblo, que colgaron a un hombre negro por robo y asesinato hace varios años sin demostrar su culpabilidad sin lugar a dudas: el padre del sacerdote. El verdadero criminal, Ray Terris, ahora también hace todo lo posible para obstaculizar al sacerdote en el cumplimiento de su tarea, durante la cual también salen a la luz sus recientes planes de robo. Pero al final, la justicia triunfa.

programme.desc: Welcome to Flavor on the Fly - In the first installment of our newest original series, Chef Ranga Perera trades the towering Rockies for the rolling hills in the Green Mountain State. Perch nuggets, sharp teeth, and hot peppers - see what lies in store for our host in the first-ever episode of “Flavor on the Fly.”

programme.title: Huckberry Homes
programme.sub-title: "How This Photographer Manifested His Dream Home on the Oregon Coast | Ep. 2 Ben Moon"
programme.desc: "For our second episode of Huckberry Homes, we set our sights on the Oregon coast and flew out to see our friends ‪@ben_moon‬ and Sophie Kuller. Tired of fixing up other people's houses, Ben decided to spend the last few years crafting his own house from the ground up, while getting help from his friends, Dad, and Sophie along the way. This one-of-a-kind home now serves as a gathering place for creatives and surfers alike, nestled between the forest and Oregon coast. - On Huckberry Homes, we’ll be tapping into the most inspiring members of the Huckberry community to offer an inside peek into how they’ve crafted the place they call home. We will showcase everything from cold plunges to vinyl listening rooms, home gyms and offices, and other tools that inspire creativity and high-performing lives. - We would like to take a moment to acknowledge the Indigenous peoples who have stewarded the land on which this video was created. This area was the home to the Nestucca peoples and other coastal tribes until the mid-1800s when the population was decimated by diseases from settlers. Those who remained were coerced into a coastal reservation by the US government. Let us remember the histories and cultures that have shaped this land."

programme.title: Huckberry Homes
programme.sub-title: "Inside This Home Builder’s Desert Hideaway in Far West Texas"
programme.desc: On this episode of Huckberry Homes, we headed out to far west Texas to meet up with our friend and Home Builder Kyle Melgaard. Over the last 5 years, Kyle and his crew at Method Building Co. have created custom and lasting spaces that compliment the vast landscape of the West Texas desert. Kyle showed us a day in his life, taking us to an active job site that he calls an office, and showcasing his unique Rammed Earth style house that him and his family call home.

programme.title: Stomping Grounds
programme.sub-title: "Lone Star Boating: Exploring Central Texas Lakes & Rivers"
programme.desc: In Episode 10 Boat Trader heads to central Texas to explore boating culture in the lone star state. Second only to Alaska in size, Texas is known as the place where everything is bigger. From big college football games to endless oil fields and vast wind farms, Texas is home to more than 30 million Americans. But the state is about more than just big oil, college football and cattle farms - it's also home to some of the best boating in the country. Boasting a myriad of waterways, boaters here enjoy hundreds of lakes, rivers and streams that provide recreational opportunities, abundant wildlife and plenty of fishing. From Austin Texas to San Antonio host Ryan McVinney and the Boat Trader crew explore the laid-back Texas lake life including boat up restaurants along the Colorado River, watersports in Austin and the history of the waterways throughout the region. Boat manufacturers highlighted in this episode are Tige Boats and ATX Surf Boats, two premium Texas-based wake boat brands known for their high-quality, cutting-edge vessels that come equipped with advanced wake shaping technologies and equipment ideal for water skiing, wake surfing and wakeboarding. There's even a wake surfing dog!

The Genius Bucket being the ultimate DIY paint kit for those looking to tackle a marine painting job on there own. The team also checks out the capabilities it takes to restoring the older metal rub rail which derived from the Glastron project.

And what better way to break in a new boat than heading to some reefs and filling the cooler with one of the Gulf of Mexico’s most popular fish?

programme.title: Chasin' The Sun
programme.desc: There’s nothing like a change in weather conditions to wreck a perfectly good fishing plan, and that’s exactly what Capt. Justin Leake and his cousin encounter when December turns unseasonably warm. It’s a grey morning with thick fog so Justin and Capt. Brent Berry won’t be heading offshore right away as planned. Instead, Justin turns to his Humminbird CoastMaster charts to pinpoint a near shore artificial reef just five minutes from the St. Andrews Pass, where the anglers will do a little fishing until the fog burns off. Capt. Leake opts to send a jig to the bottom and he’s not very picky about the one that gets tied on. “When fishing reefs, the specific jig doesn’t matter because it’s all about the presentation,” he says. “When you’re sitting on top of a wreck, break out the ‘junk jigs’ – they get bit just fine.” And that proves to be the case as Justin and Brent enjoy non-stop battles against amberjack, red snapper and bonita. And with a bite this good, there’s no reason to go anywhere else! Also, we take a look at the United States Coast Guard Auxiliary’s new paddle craft safety initiative.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way

programme.title: THE WAWIES
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

programme.desc: The segment features three diverse luxury vessels: the long-range comfort of the Absolute Navetta 62 trawler yacht; the high-speed performance of the Mystic M4200 (PBIBS 2025) center console with raceboat heritage; and the elegant Sirena 48 Coupe (PBIBS 2025), an owner-operated yacht known for its efficient hull and open design.

programme.title: The Boat Show – Episode 192
programme.desc: This episode is dedicated to performance and versatility, highlighting the 50-knot Italian maxi-RIB Mar.co E44 with its luxury cabin. programme.desc: This episode covers Italian design and high performance, featuring the stylish Ranieri Sauvage 34 luxury RIB and the premier charter offerings of Spartivento. programme.title: The Boat Show – Episode 194
programme.desc: This episode features the sleek De Antonio D60, a 60-foot Spanish yacht renowned for its clean deck and hidden outboards, alongside a look at the innovative Euthalia lightning protection system. programme.title: Noches violentas
programme.desc: Un hombre disfruta ver a su esposa envolverse con hombres strippers, por otro lado y en medio de este ambiente dos mujeres contratadas por este hombre seducen al jefe de seguridad de una discoteca, quien posteriormente es culpado de un asesinato que no cometió, después de muchos crímenes a mujeres strippers, se dan cuenta que alguien más es el asesino, pero necesitarán de mucha astucia para encontrarlo.

programme.title: Reinas de la calle
programme.desc: Cuando una de las amigas de la líder de una pandilla de LA es brutalmente golpeada por su novio, las "Hoodrats" cobran venganza. programme.title: Se lo dije, Lucecita
programme.desc: Una hermosa chica veinteañera llamada Lucecita, se fuga con un hombre cada sábado armando un escándalo en el pueblo. En ese lugar vive Don Pancho Rueda, un hombre de 50 años. Cuenta la leyenda que posee un enorme miembro viril, que cada vez que lo usa desgracia a las muchachas para siempre.

programme.title: 12 segundos
